scenes.headline: How routed values fit an ordinary cache
scenes.sub: Read from its own modelling code.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bagel! This K2-Horizon model puts a mixture of experts inside attention itself. Here's how it does that without growing the cache.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Route the value projection through 64 experts, but mix them before the cache. The cache stores one ordinary GQA value per token.
scenes.say: Route the value projection through sixty-four experts, but mix them before the cache. Then the cache stores one ordinary value per token.

scenes.title: What a value is now
scenes.text: v = Σ w_k · SiLU(V_k x), top 4 of 64
scenes.say: Where attention had one value projection, this has sixty-four, and each token runs four.

parts.note: one of 64 full value projections: 2,560 in, 1,024 out
parts.say: Each expert is a whole value projection, to eight heads of a hundred and twenty-eight.

parts.note: a non-linear gate on each expert's output
parts.say: Each output goes through a non-linear activation, so the value is no longer a linear map of the token.

parts.note: router weight: sigmoid, renormalised, scaled by 2.5
parts.say: And the router's sigmoid scores, renormalised and scaled by two and a half, weight the four.

steps.say: A router reads each token and picks four of the sixty-four value experts.
Their outputs are summed and reshaped to eight heads of a hundred and twenty-eight: exactly what a plain grouped-query layer writes.

steps.note: the routing is thrown away before the cache
steps.say: Only then is the cache updated. It holds ordinary shapes, so FlashAttention runs unmodified, and never learns routing happened.

scenes.title: MoVA against a plain value projection
scenes.say: So the cost moves from cache to weights: sixty-four times the parameters, four times the decode work, the same cache.

scenes.label: of KV cache for one 512K-token sequence: all 48 layers are full attention
scenes.note: no extra cache is not the same as a small cache
scenes.say: But no extra cache isn't a small cache. All forty-eight layers are full attention, so one sequence at the full context holds ninety-six gigabytes.

scenes.text: Collapse the mixture before the cache, and everything downstream stays ordinary. The cost moves from cache to weights.
scenes.mark: Collapse the mixture before the cache
scenes.say: Collapse the mixture before the cache, and everything downstream stays ordinary. The cost moves from the cache to the weights.

recap: Mixed into one GQA value before caching
64x the weights, 4x the work, 1x the cache
scenes.say: To recap: sixty-four value experts, mixed before the cache, paid for in weights instead of memory.
